arcs.title: The Briefcase
arcs.summary: Day 3: The briefcase has acquired a brass name tag on the clasp — not Quoyne's name, not any current Ministry employee. The tag begins with 'C' and is finely engraved. The Department of Mysteries said 'Ah' and withdrew. The briefcase has begun to hum faintly. Quoyne is filing this under Pending. No one has tried the lock. Day 4 (resolution): The briefcase should find its way — by its own apparent navigation — to Christine or to Gringotts. Its contents, when finally opened, should be a warm, funny payoff consistent with the Pulp Fiction glowing-briefcase easter egg tradition: something that makes complete sense in hindsight, is entirely Christine's, and which the Ministry will file under 'Wholesome, Misc.' once more.
